edges.reason: The oxeye_daisy is in the same garden zone as the sweet_berry_bush; player must navigate to this area first to find and mine the flower
The honeycomb_block wall is in the garden zone near the berry bushes; player discovers this area by finding the bushes first
Honeycomb blocks physically wall off the crafting table at (4,0,-9); player must mine through them to access the table for crafting
The red_sandstone_slabs border the nether canyon adjacent to the lavafall; player must navigate to the lava area to find and mine the slabs
The quartz_slab floor is in the same nether canyon as the lavafall; player discovers both features in the same eastern area
Finding the white_bed means the player has located and entered the dark house; they can then place torches to illuminate it

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The sweet berry bushes are at (0, 0, -7) relative to spawn in the garden zone. Player must navigate north and face the bushes. Max distance 16 and facing tolerance 60 degrees models 'player can see the target'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lavafall flows down the netherrack wall at (11, 2, 0) relative to spawn. Player must navigate east and face the lava cascade. Target y=2 is the midpoint of the flowing lava column for natural viewing angle.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white bed is inside the dark house at (-10, 1, 1) relative to spawn. Max distance 8 since the bed is inside a structure requiring the player to enter or stand at the doorway to see it. Facing tolerance 60 degrees ensures player is looking toward the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining a flower causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. Oxeye daisies break instantly by hand and always drop themselves. The player starts with no oxeye_daisy in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining a honeycomb_block causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. Honeycomb blocks can be mined by any tool or by hand and always drop themselves. This also opens the physical gate to the crafting table behind the honeycomb wall.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red_sandstone_slab with a pickaxe causes it to drop as an item into the player's inventory. The player has a wooden_pickaxe which is sufficient. Slabs require a pickaxe to drop — mining by hand yields nothing.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The quartz slabs form the canyon floor at (9, 0, 1) relative to spawn. Target offset from center so player approaches from the side rather than standing directly on top. Wider facing tolerance of 75 degrees accounts for the downward viewing angle needed for floor-level slabs.

Uses inventory_has because crafting leather_leggings results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 8 leather and must access the crafting table (gated behind honeycomb wall) to craft using the 7-leather leggings recipe pattern. Player starts with no leather_leggings.

Uses count_in_box_at_least because lighting up a house requires placing torch blocks inside the structure. Two rules check for floor-placed 'torch' blocks AND wall-placed 'wall_torch' blocks within the house volume (-12,1,-3) to (-7,4,3). Either type satisfies the milestone since both provide illumination. In Minecraft, right-clicking a horizontal surface creates 'torch' and right-clicking a vertical surface creates 'wall_torch' — both are valid ways to light a room.

scene_description: A compact three-zone scene radiating from player spawn at midnight. NORTH (z=-7 to -10): Garden/bee zone with sweet berry bushes, oxeye daisies, and a crafting table physically gated behind a honeycomb block wall. EAST (x=7-11): Nether-themed canyon with a single-source lavafall, quartz slab floor, and red sandstone slab border. WEST (x=-7 to -12): A dark oak plank house containing a white bed that needs torch illumination. Universal dirt layer at y=-1 ensures all blocks have proper ground support.
task_text: Explore this area to find a sweet berry bush garden, a lavafall in a canyon, and a white bed inside a dark house. Mine the oxeye daisy and honeycomb blocks in the garden to access the crafting table and craft leather leggings. Mine a red sandstone slab near the lava and find the quartz slab floor. Finally, light up the dark house with torches.
design_notes: V3 final design with all critical fixes: (1) Universal dirt at y=-1 ensures ground support for all surface blocks. (2) Garden zone grass_block fill extends to z=-10 at y=0 covering berry bush locations. Berry bushes at y=0 replace grass and are supported by dirt at y=-1. (3) Crafting table at (4,0,-9) sealed behind honeycomb wall at x=3 (z=-8 to -10, 2 blocks tall) with stone on back (z=-10) and sides (x=4 at z=-8 and above crafting table). Only path to table is through honeycomb. (4) Single lava source at (11,4,0) flows naturally down netherrack back wall. (5) Quartz slabs inset at (8-10,0,-1 to 1) for natural viewing. (6) Red sandstone slabs at z=-4 border row. (7) House has 2-block doorway at (-7,1-2,0), interior cleared, white bed at (-10/-11,1,1). (8) Midnight setting makes house dark for meaningful torch placement task.
